description: Searches Aisle wedding planning guides by keywords and returns up to 10 relevant excerpts with links to the full articles, at most 3 from any one guide unless a different per-guide limit is supplied.

max_per_guide.description: How many sections one guide may hold among the 10 results (default 3). 1 gives one entry per guide; 10 ranks sections with no per-guide limit.

query.description: Search query keywords (e.g. "legal requirements Italy", "budget tips", "what to wear")

name: search_guides
title: Search Wedding Planning Guides
